CJP leader Abhijeet Dipke calls for pause in protests until Diwali

Abhijeet Dipke, founder of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP), has appealed to his supporters to pause demonstrations until Diwali and spend time with their families. This call came before the CJP's 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march and amid protests by the INDIA bloc. Dipke was reportedly detained by Delhi Police prior to the CJP's planned march, but was later released. The CJP's movement and the INDIA bloc's protests are described as being for the same cause.
